_readme: Chrome 155.0.8059.79, --disable-gpu, willReadFrequently, standards-mode page. hw = arm64 (macOS), sw = x64 macOS build under Rosetta (SSE only), fma = linux64 headless shell under qemu -cpu max (AVX2+FMA+F16C). sw/fma only where they differ from hw; fma was not measured for I6/I7 (size checks only). NaN/Inf/-0 are strings. E* keep the decoded PNG samples or the sha256 of other encodings.
